name: compliance-audit
description: Audits a product repo (FastAPI/Go backends, Postgres, Redis, Railway, native iOS/Android incl. Capacitor, web/SaaS) for legal and regulatory compliance gaps: privacy (GDPR/UK, US states, Israel, Singapore), app store rules, EU digital acts (DSA, AI Act, CRA, EAA), payments, AI features, minors, open-source licensing/SBOM and security baseline. Publishes a claude.ai Artifact report with findings ranked by legal risk — each explaining the rule, file:line evidence, the fix and the owner — plus shared In progress / Done / Won't fix statuses. An apply skill then implements the open cards one PR at a time, in dependency order, until merged. Not legal advice.
